description: Express Entry category-based draw definitions for 2026. Versioned — update when IRCC publishes changes.
disclaimer: Informational only. Not immigration advice. Verify against current IRCC publications.

changes_from_2025.rule_change: Minimum work experience for category eligibility increased from 6 months to 12 months, accumulated within the previous 3 years. Need not be continuous.

verification_legend.verified: NOC list transcribed from IRCC's published list and checked.
verification_legend.unverified: Category confirmed to exist for 2026, but the NOC list here is incomplete or not yet checked against IRCC. Code must NOT assert eligibility from an unverified list — surface it as 'needs verification' instead.

categories.label: STEM
categories.description: Science, Technology, Engineering and Mathematics occupations

categories.label: Health care and social services
categories.description: Health care and social services occupations

categories.label: Education
categories.description: Education occupations. Includes university professors and lecturers, post-secondary teaching and research assistants, and school teachers.
categories.verification_note: Confirmed as a renewed 2026 category. Re-check the exact NOC list against IRCC before asserting eligibility.

categories.label: Transport
categories.verification_note: Confirmed as a new 2026 category. The 2025 transport NOC list was retired with the category redesign; do not reuse it. Needs the published 2026 list.

categories.label: Physicians with Canadian work experience
categories.description: Medical doctors with Canadian work experience. Newly introduced for 2026.
categories.verification_note: Confirmed as a new 2026 category requiring Canadian work experience. Re-check the exact NOC list against IRCC.

categories.label: Senior managers with Canadian work experience
categories.description: Senior managers in construction, transportation, production, utilities, financial, communications and other business services, with Canadian work experience.
categories.verification_note: Confirmed as a new 2026 category requiring Canadian work experience. Needs the published NOC 00-series list.

categories.label: Researchers with Canadian work experience
categories.description: Researchers with Canadian work experience. Newly introduced for 2026.
categories.verification_note: Confirmed as a new 2026 category requiring Canadian work experience. Needs the published NOC list.

categories.label: Skilled military recruits
categories.description: Skilled military recruits with a Canadian Armed Forces job offer.
categories.verification_note: Eligibility is driven by a Canadian Armed Forces job offer rather than by NOC alone. Not inferable from a job posting; exclude from job-level scoring.

categories.label: French-language proficiency
categories.description: All TEER 0-3 NOCs when the candidate has strong French proficiency (NCLC 7+). Not NOC-list restricted.
